acquisition method: An information dependent acquisition method consisted of an Orbitrap MS survey scan of mass range 300–2000 m/z followed by HCD fragmentation for 10 most intense peptide ions.
cleavage agent: Beads were washed with Tris buffer (pH 8.0) and digested with trypsin at the Turku Proteomics Facility according to the standard protocol.
enrichment method: DICER was immunoprecipitated from 17–18 dpp mouse testes as described above.
fragmentation method: followed by HCD fragmentation for 10 most intense peptide ions.
instrument: coupled to the Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany)
ionization type: equipped with a nano-electrospray ionization source.
labeling: MS data was acquired automatically by using Thermo Xcalibur 3.1 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
